ValidationRule.description: This Event Manager field should be populated for an Open Day / AED event (Eventbrite events)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Event_Type__c, "Open Day"), ISPICKVAL(Event_Type__c, "AED") ), ISBLANK(Event_Manager__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter an Event Manager for this type of Event
